info.title: solfège iPad Exam API
info.description: solfège iPad practice and exam API. Practice uses immediate measure-level self-assessment without an AI job; Exam retains asynchronous OpenRouter grading and Korean feedback. Attempt snapshots pin the problem, playback plan and Feature v1 analysis. API-CONTRACT.md defines invariants; legacy requests without mode remain Exam. Password login uses one persistent, revocable DRF bearer token per user and shared PostgreSQL login limits. Signup, signup availability and account deletion from API contract v0.8.0 are implemented. Items marked x-status: planned (grading quotas) are defined by contract v0.8.0 and are not implemented yet. From contract v0.8.0, absolute URLs in responses (asset urls, image_url, template_png_url, next/previous, Location) use the public origin that received the request, including behind an HTTPS proxy. A proxy in front of the server may return non-contract error responses (HTML body, no X-Request-ID) when the server is unavailable or the request is blocked; clients treat an undecodable error other than 401 as a server connection problem, do not branch on error.code, and never change authentication state for it. Server 401 responses always use the contract format. Version 0.9.0 adds authenticated, idempotent Rhythm Puzzle drill observations with server-side sounding-time regrading; all authentication and Practice/Exam contracts are retained. Version 0.10.0 makes learning_goal optional at signup: an omitted goal is stored and returned as null until PATCH /me/ sets one, and null means not chosen yet, unlike other. Version 0.11.0 adds POST /auth/username-check/, an advisory public username availability check with its own per-IP limit; signup 409 USERNAME_TAKEN stays authoritative.

post.summary: Log in with username and password
post.description: Ignores Authorization, including invalid bearer headers. Body limit 32 KiB; then IP rolling limit 30 admitted requests/5 minutes (server setting LOGIN_MAX_REQUESTS_PER_IP from v0.8.0, default 30; from v0.8.0 the client IP is the address reported by a trusted proxy only for requests from that proxy); then input validation; then username block for 5 minutes after five authentication failures/5 minutes. An IP-limited request can only inspect a valid username block, never verify credentials. If both limits apply use the longer remaining delay and ceil Retry-After seconds. Do not automatically retry. No Idempotency-Key. Credentials are not normalized. Profile UUID matches /me/. Concurrent login and credential updates are serialized; password changes and deactivation revoke tokens atomically.

delete.description: No request body and no password re-confirmation: the app asks for confirmation, and any body is neither read nor validated. Order: 401, 403 ACCOUNT_DELETION_NOT_ALLOWED, 204. Deletes the user, profile, token, attempts, answers, grading jobs, idempotency receipts, the username's login failure record and answer images; AI usage records are kept without the user link. Requests from the same user that overlap the deletion and fail because the user no longer exists return 401, not 500. No Idempotency-Key and no automatic retry.

put.summary: Save a full Practice self-assessment snapshot
put.description: Practice only. Send the whole errors list, expected_revision and completed. The first submission is revision 0. Each successful save appends one revision. A stale expected_revision returns 409 SELF_ASSESSMENT_REVISION_CONFLICT and preserves both server history and the client draft. Use the same Idempotency-Key and payload to recover an uncertain response. A completed empty list explicitly means no errors found; pending does not. Exam returns 409 SELF_ASSESSMENT_NOT_AVAILABLE.
